mapper.sql: SELECT t.source_day_result_id, SUM(CASE WHEN t.action='APPLY' THEN t.transfer_minutes WHEN t.action='REVERSE' THEN -t.transfer_minutes ELSE 0 END) transferred_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN t.action='APPLY' AND reversed.transfer_id IS NULL AND (d.day_result_id IS NULL OR d.settled_at IS NULL OR NOT(d.row_version <=> t.source_version) OR NOT(d.schedule_id <=> t.source_schedule_id) OR NOT(d.user_id <=> t.user_id) OR NOT(d.shop_id <=> t.shop_id) OR NOT(d.business_date <=> t.source_business_date) OR NOT(d.worked_minutes <=> t.source_worked_minutes) OR NOT(d.scheduled_minutes <=> t.source_scheduled_minutes) OR NOT(d.settled_at <=> t.source_settled_at) OR COALESCE(s.status,'')<>'PUBLISHED' OR NOT(s.user_id <=> t.user_id) OR NOT(s.shop_id <=> t.shop_id) OR NOT(s.business_date <=> t.source_business_date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) invalid_count FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer t LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_overtime_transfer reversed ON reversed.original_transfer_id=t.transfer_id AND reversed.action='REVERSE' LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_day_result d ON d.day_result_id=t.source_day_result_id LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_schedule s ON s.schedule_id=d.schedule_id GROUP BY t.source_day_result_id
mapper.select: select d.day_result_id, s.schedule_id, s.user_id, coalesce(d.user_name, s.user_name) user_name, s.shop_id, s.business_date, s.shift_id, coalesce(d.scheduled_minutes, s.standard_minutes_snapshot, 0) scheduled_minutes, coalesce(d.worked_minutes, 0) worked_minutes, coalesce(d.paid_leave_minutes, 0) paid_leave_minutes, coalesce(d.unpaid_leave_minutes, 0) unpaid_leave_minutes, coalesce(d.absence_minutes, 0) absence_minutes, coalesce(d.late_minutes, 0) late_minutes, coalesce(d.early_leave_minutes, 0) early_leave_minutes, greatest(coalesce(d.worked_minutes, 0) - coalesce(d.scheduled_minutes, s.standard_minutes_snapshot, 0), 0) raw_overtime_minutes, coalesce(tc_source.used_minutes, 0) time_credit_used_minutes, coalesce(ot.transferred_minutes,0) overtime_transferred_minutes, coalesce(ot.invalid_count,0) overtime_transfer_invalid, greatest(coalesce(d.worked_minutes, 0) - coalesce(d.scheduled_minutes, s.standard_minutes_snapshot, 0), 0) - coalesce(tc_source.used_minutes, 0) - coalesce(ot.transferred_minutes,0) net_overtime_minutes, coalesce(tc_target.offset_minutes, 0) time_credit_offset_minutes, coalesce(d.early_leave_minutes, 0) - coalesce(tc_target.offset_minutes, 0) net_early_leave_minutes, case when d.day_result_id is null then 'MISSING_RESULT' else d.result_status end result_status, case when d.day_result_id is null then 'MISSING_DAY_RESULT' else d.exception_codes end exception_codes, d.first_in_event_id, d.last_out_event_id, d.first_in_correction_request_id, d.last_out_correction_request_id, d.calculation_version, d.calculated_at, d.settled_at, d.row_version from oa_attendance_schedule s left join oa_attendance_day_result d on d.schedule_id = s.schedule_id left join ( select source_day_result_id, sum(case when adjustment_action = 'APPLY' then adjustment_minutes when adjustment_action = 'REVERSE' then -adjustment_minutes else 0 end) used_minutes from oa_attendance_time_credit_adjustment group by source_day_result_id ) tc_source on tc_source.source_day_result_id = d.day_result_id LEFT JOIN () ot ON ot.source_day_result_id=d.day_result_id left join ( select target_day_result_id, sum(case when adjustment_action = 'APPLY' then adjustment_minutes when adjustment_action = 'REVERSE' then -adjustment_minutes else 0 end) offset_minutes from oa_attendance_time_credit_adjustment group by target_day_result_id ) tc_target on tc_target.target_day_result_id = d.day_result_id where s.shop_id = #{shopId} and s.status = 'PUBLISHED' and s.business_date between #{dateFrom} and #{dateTo} order by s.business_date, s.user_id, s.schedule_id
